spans.s:
ind.
A depreciative particle, implying,
1 Pain, trouble, (bad, difficult, ill.)
2 Inferiority, (bad, vile, contemptible.)
3 Prohibition, (away, hold, forbear.)
It corresponds in general to the English prefixes, in, un, &c. as in infamous, unbearable, and the like.
E.
दो to cut or divide, डुर affix. In composition, the final र is changed to visarga, and this to a sibilant optionally before the two first consonants of each class and the sibilants, as दुःकर, दुष्कर; and दुःसह, दुस्सह; or to र again before any other consonant or vowel, as दुर्ग, दुरतिक्रम &c. q. v.

n. (-क्षं)
A loaded or fraudulent die or dice.
E.
दुर्, and अक्ष a die.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Difficult to be suppressed or overcome, insuperable, unconquerable.
2 Difficult of performance or accomplishment.
E.
दुर्, and अतिक्रम overcoming.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Difficult to be passed or overcome.
E.
दुर्, and अत्यय going over or beyond.

n. (-ष्टं)
Bad luck, misfortune.
E.
दुर्, and अदृष्ट fortune.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Difficult to be traversed.
2 Difficult to be read through or studied.
2 Insurmountable, difficult to be overcome.
E.
दुर्, and अधिगम going over.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Difficult of attainment or of acquirement.
2 Difficult of perusal.
E.
दुर्, and अध्यय going over.

m. (-ध्वः)
A bad road.
E.
दुर् bad, अध्वन् a road, अच् substituted for the final syllable of the last member of the compound.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Ending ill, having a bad end.
E.
दुर्, and अन्त end.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Difficult to be displeased or offended.
E.
दुर्, and अपचार offence.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Difficult to be taken or laid hold of.
m. (-हः)
A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.)
f. (-हा)
Cowach.
E.
दुर्, and अभिग्रह taking.

m. (-कः)
A barbarian.
E.
दुर् bad, vile, आक Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Difficult to be passed.
2 Invincible.
E.
दुर्, and आङ् before क्रम to go, अच् aff.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Wicked, depraved, following evil practices.
2 Disregarding or deviating from established practices.
m. (-रः)
Wickedness.
E.
दुर् bad, आचार observance.

mfn. (-ढ्यः-ढ्या-ढ्यं)
Poor, not rich.
E.
दुर्, and आढ्य rich.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Who does any thing with difficulty though rich.
2 What is done by one not rich.
E.
दुराढ्य, कृ to do, खल् aff.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
1 Proceeding from one not rich. Produced with difficulty by one who is rich.
E.
दुराढ्य, भू to be, खल aff.

mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म)
Vile, wicked, bad.
m. (-त्मा)
A rascal, a scoundrel, a villain.
E.
दुर्, and आत्मन् soul.

mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं)
Haughty, intractable.
m. (-र्षः)
Whitemustard.
E.
दुर्, and आधर्ष pride.

mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि)
Painful, distressing.
E.
दुर्, and आधि affliction.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
Difficult of attainment.
E.
दुर्, आप to obtain, क aff.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Of difficult ascent.
m. (-हः)
1 The palm tree.
2 The date tree.
f. (-हा)
The silk cotton tree.
E.
दुर with difficulty, आरोह to be ascended, from रुह to rise, with आङ् prefixed, affixes अच् and टाप्.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
1 Unfit to be touched or taken, difficult of handling.
2 Difficult of attainment.
f. (-भा)
A prickly plant, commonly Javāsa, (Hedysarum alhagi.)
E.
दुर्, bad, hardly, लभ to attain, with आङ् prefixed, affix खल, fem. affix टाप्: see the next.

f. (-म्भा)
A plant, Javāsa: see the preceding.
E.
as above, नुम् optionally inserted.

m. (-पः)
Abuse, scurrilous or abusive language.
E.
दुर् bad, आलाप address.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Painfully bright, dazzling, not to be looked at.
m. (-कः)
Great brightness or splendour.
E.
दुर्, and आलोक seeing.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Difficult of shelter or asylum.
E.
दुर्, and आशय resting place.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Difficult to be overcome or expelled.
E.
दुर्, and आस to sit, खल् aff.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Difficult of attainment.
2 Difficult of access.
3 Unequalled, unrivalled.
4 Intolerable.
E.
दुर् with difficulty, आङ् implying to or up to, सद to go, affix अच्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Sinful, wicked.
n. (-तं)
Sin.
E.
दुर् vile, bad, इत gone, become.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Very bad, very wicked.
n. (-ष्ठं)
Great crime, extreme wickedness.
E.
दुर् bad, vile, and इष्ठन् superlative aff.

f. (-णा)
1 Curse, cursing.
2 An evil eye.
E.
दुर् bad, ईषणा seeing.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Impassable, difficult to be crossed.
2 Unanswerable.
E.
दुर्, and उत्तर going over.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Difficult to be articulated or pronounced.
E.
दुर्, and उदाहर pronouncing.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Burthensome, unbearable.
E.
दुर्, and उद्वह up-bearing.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Difficult of access or approach.
2 Difficult of cure.
E.
दुर्, and उपक्रम approach.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Difficult of cure.
2 Unmanageable.
E.
दुर्, and उपचार implement.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Unapproachable, unattainable.
E.
दुर्, and उपस्थान proximity.

m. (-रः)
1 A gamester.
2 A stake.
n. (-रं)
Playing, gaming.
E.
दुर् bad, reprehensible, उदर contest.

mfn. (-र्गः-र्गा-र्गं)
1 Difficult of access or approach, inaccessible, impervious, impermeable.
2 Difficult of attainment, unattainable.
n. (-र्गं)
1 A fort, a strong hold, a Droog or hill fort.
2 A pass, a defile, a difficult or narrow passage over a stream or a mountain, or through a wood, &c.
m. (-र्गः)
The name of an Asura slain by DURGĀ.
f. (-र्गा)
1 The goddess DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA, and mother of KĀRTTIKEYA, and GAṆEŚA; also called UMĀ, and PĀRVATĪ, &c.: as DURGĀ, she is a goddess of terrific form, and irascible temper, and particularly worshipped at the DURGĀ Pūjā, held in Bengal in the month of Āśvina, or about

October.
2

The indigo plant.
3 A creeping shrub, (Clitoria ternata.)
4 A singing bird, the Śyāmā.
E.
दुर् bad, ill, with difficulty, गम to go, affix ड; the etymology of the goddess is thus given, दुर् with difficulty, गम to be known; a knowledge of whom is obtained only by the severest austerities; or दुर् bad, गै to sing, who is especially hymned by the wicked; or दुर्ग the Asura slain by the goddess.

mn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मं)
Enterprize, difficult undertaking.
E.
दुर्ग, and कर्म्म act.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Making difficult or impassable.
n. (-कं)
The Bhojpatra or birch.
E.
दुर्ग an impervious thicket, and कारक making.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Poor, indigent, distressed.
2 Suffering pain or affliction.
E.
दुर ill, गत gone, become.

Hell.
2

Poverty, indigence.
3 A difficult path or site.
E.
दुर् bad, ill, गति going.

f. (-नी)
DURGĀ.
E.
दुर्गति hell, नाशिनी who destroys.

mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि)
Staying in a stronghold.
E.
दुर्ग, and निवासिन् who abides.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Ill-smelling, ill-scented.
m. (-न्धः)
1 Any ill-smelling substance.
2 The mango tree.
n. (-न्धं)
Socāl salt.
E.
दुर् bad, vile, and गन्ध smell.

mfn. (-न्धी-न्धिनी-न्धि)
Ill-smelling.
E.
दुर्गन्ध a bad smell, and इनि aff.

n. (-रं)
A fortified city.
E.
दुर्ग, and पुर a city.

f. (-ष्पी)
A plant, commonly Keśāpuṣpa.
E.
दुर्ग with difficulty, पुष्पी a flower.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
1 Inaccessible, difficult of access or approach.
2 Unattainable, difficult of attainment.
E.
दुर् with pain or difficulty, गम to go, affix अप्; see दुर्ग.

m. (-र्गः)
A defile, a difficult pass or way.
E.
दुर्ग, and मार्ग a road.

mfn. (-नः-नी-नं)
1 Overcoming difficulties, making way through arduous passages or affairs, &c.
m. (-नः)
A camel.
E.
दुर्ग, and लङ्घन who traverses.

n. (-नं)
Defect in a citadel, its being ill-guarded, &c.
E.
दुर्ग, and व्यसन misfortune.

m. (-रः)
1 Progress or passage through an almost impervious or inaccessible spot.
2 A bridge, &c. or any contrivance for passing a river, a defile, &c.
E.
दुर्ग a defile, &c. सञ्चर going; also with संचार, दुर्गसंचार m. (-रः)

f. (-द्-त्)
Essential part of a fortress.
E.
दुर्ग, and सम्पद् wealth.

m. (-री)
The governor of a fort.
E.
दुर्ग, and अधिकारिन् who superintends.

m. (-क्षः)
The governor of a fortress.
E.
दुर्ग, and अध्यक्ष supervisor.

f. (-मी)
The ninth of the light half of Kārttika, sacred to DURGA as JAGADDHĀTRĪ.
E.
दुर्गा, and नवमी the ninth.

m. (-धः)
Investing or besieging a fortress.
E.
दुर्ग, and अवरोध investing.

n. (-णं)
Taking refuge in a fortress.
E.
दुर्ग, and आश्रयण seeking shelter.

mfn. (-षः-षा-षं)
Harsh-voiced, roaring, bellowing.
m. (-षः)
1 A bear.
2 A loud or disagreeable cry.
E.
दुर्, and घोष sound.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Bad, wicked, vile.
2 Malicious, mischief-making.
m. (-नः)
A bad man.
E.
दुर् bad, vile, जन a man.

n. (-त्वं)
Wickedness, villainy.
E.
त्व added to दुर्ज्जन; also with तल् affix दुर्ज्जनता.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Invincible, difficult to be subdued or overcome.
E.
दुर्, and जय victory.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Difficult of digestion, indigestible.
E.
दुर्, and जर digesting.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Inauspiciously born or produced.
2 Improper.
n. (-तं)
1 Misfortune, calamity.
2 Disparity, unconformity, impropriety.
E.
दुर् bad, जात born.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
1 Vile, wicked.
2 Low, outcaste.
E.
दुर्, जाति kind.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Difficult to be known or understood.
E.
दुर्, and ज्ञेय to be known.

m. (-यः)
Want of conduct, impropriety, impolicy.
E.
दुर्, and नय policy.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Ill-behaved, ill-governed.
2 Impolitic.
n. (-तं)
1

Misconduct.
2

Impolicy.
E.
दुर्, and नीत conducted.

Impolicy.
2

Misconduct.
E.
दुर्, and नीति policy.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Difficult to be subdued.
E.
दुर्, and दम taming.

Tearing.
2

Distressing.
m. (-रः)
A kind of drug, Ṛṣabha.
E.
दुर्, and दर what tears.

mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं)
Dazzling, painful to the sight.
2 Difficult to be seen or met with.
E.
दुर्, and दर्श seeing.

mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
Untameable, intractable, difficult to be restrained or disciplined.
m. (-न्तः)
1 Strife, tumult.
2 A calf.
E.
दुर्, and दान्त daunted.

n. (-नं)
1 A dark or cloudy day.
2 Rain, or cloudy and rainy weather.
E.
दुर् bad, vile, दिन a day.

m. (-टः)
An atheist.
E.
दुर् vile, repeated, अट to go or be, affix घञ्, and उ substituted for the penultimate.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Ill seen, (literally or figuratively,) ill-examined, imperfectly investigated.
2 Looked at with an evil eye.
E.
दुर् bad, दृष्ट seen.

n. (-वं)
Bad luck, misfortune.
E.
ठुर्, and दैव fate.

m. (-टः)
A pupil who obeys his teacher only after judging of the propriety of obedience.

f. (-ता)
A creeping plant.

m. (-मः)
A green onion.
E.
दुर् bad, and द्रुम a tree: see दुद्रुम.

mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं)
1 Difficult of attainment or approach.
2 Haughty, distant.
E.
धर्ष, and दुर् pride.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Difficult to be sustained or borne, troublesome, unbearable.
2 Irresistible, difficult to be restrained.
m. (-रः)
1 A division of hell.
2 A kind of drug, commonly Ṛṣabha.
3 The name of an Asura or Titan.
E.
दुर् bad, ill, धर having, possessing; it is also written दुर्द्धैर.

n. (-कं)
Hæmorrhoids.
E.
दुर् bad, नामन् a name, and कन् added: see the next.

mf. (-मा-म्नी)
A cockle.
n. (-म)
Piles or hæmorrhoids.
E.
दुर् bad, and नामन् a name, fem. affix टाप् or ङीष्; also in the first sense, with a final vowel दुर्नामा, f. (-मा.)

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Ungovernable, difficult of restraint.
E.
दुर्, and निर्ग्रंह restraint.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Difficult to be stopped, hindered, contradicted, &c.
2 Invincible, unconquerable.
E.
दुर्, and निवार resistance.

mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं)
Hard to be looked at, as the sun, &c.
E.
दुर्, and निरीक्ष्य to be seen.

r. 1st cl. (ई) दुर्व्वी (दूर्व्वति)
To hurt, to injure, to wound, to kill, &c.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Feeble, thin, emaciated.
2 Weak, impotent.
m. (-लः)
One who is circumcised, or whose glans penis is void of prepuce.
E.
दुर् implying depreciation or diminution, and बल strong, potent.

mfn. (-द्धिः-द्धिः-द्धि)
Silly, ignorant.
E.
दुर्, and बुद्धि understanding.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
To be eaten with difficulty.
E.
दुर्, and भक्ष eating.

f. (-गा)
1 A wife not loved or liked by her husband.
2 A bad or ill tempered woman.
E.
दुर् little or ill, भग affection.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Burdensome, troublesome, hard to be supported.
E.
दुर्, and भर what bears.

n. (-क्षं)
Dearth, famine.
E.
दुर्, and भिक्षा alms; when charity ceases.

mfn. (-ग्यः-ग्या-ग्यं)
Unfortunate, unlucky.
E.
दुर्, and भाग्य fortune.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
1 To be broken with difficulty.
2 Firm, constant, not easily disunited.
E.
दुर्, and भेद्य to be broken.

mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति)
Silly, ignorant, simple, a blockhead.
E.
दुर्, and मति mind.

mfn. (-नाः-नाः-नः)
Sad, distressed, meditating or thinking sorrowfully.
E.
दुर् distress, मनस् the mind.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Dying with difficulty, retentive of life.
f. (-रा)
Bent grass: see दूर्ब्बा.
E.
दुर् with difficulty, मृ to perish, affix अच्.

f. (-का)
A minor drama, a comedy, a farce.

mfn. (-खः-खा-खी-खं)
1 Scurrilous, foul-mouthed.
2 Hideous, ugly.
m. (-खः)
1 One of the monkey chiefs.
2 One of the principal Nāgas or serpents.
3 A horse.
3 An Asura.
E.
दुर् bad, ill, मुख mouth or face.

n. (-ल्यं)
Any thing of high price or value.
E.
दुर्, and मूल्य price.

mfn. (-धाः-धाः-धः)
Of little or contemptible understanding, [] dull, stupid, ignorant, uninformed.
E.
दुर् bad, मेधस् understanding.

m. (-नः)
The elder of the Kuru princes, and leader in the war against his cousins, the Pāṇḍus and KṚṢṆA.
E.
दुर् vile, ill, युध to make war, affix युच्; the author and leader of an unjust warfare.

mfn. (-निः-निः-नि)
Of low or impure origin.
E.
दुर्, and योनि place of birth.

mfn. (-भः-भा-भं)
1 Difficult of attainment.
2 Excellent, eminent.
3 Dear, beloved.
m. (-भः)
A plant, (a sort of Hedysarum): see दुरालभा.
f. (-भा)
A prickly nightshade.
E.
दुर् difficult, लभ to gain, affix खल्, but without any nasal.

mfn. (-चः-चा-चं)
1 Speaking ill or improperly.
2 Speaking in pain.
3 Difficult of utterance or articulation.
4 What ought not to be spoken.
n. (-चं)
1 Abuse, censure.
2 Evil or unlucky speech.
E.
दुर्; वच to speak, क aff.

n. (-चः)
Abuse, bad language.
E.
दुर् bad, वचस्, speech.

mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं)
Of a bad species or class.
n. (-र्णं)
1

Silver.
2

A sort of perfume, commonly Elavāluka: see एलवालुक.
E.
दुर् bad, vile, and वर्ण species; the reduplication of the व is optional in this and the following words.

n. (-कं)
Silver.
E.
दुर् inferior, वर्ण species, कन् pleonasm; inferior as compared with gold.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Difficult to be borne or supported.
E.
दुर्, and वह bearing.

mfn. (-वाक्)
An ill speaker, morally or physically.
f. (-वाच्)
Speaking ill, either inelegantly or abusively.
E.
दुर् ill, वाच् speech.

n. (-च्यं)
Any unlucky or ill omened speech.
2 Censure, abuse.
E.
दुर् improperly, वाच्य to be spoken.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
One who speaks ill, (grammatically, &c.) or one who utters abusive or unbecoming language.
E.
दुर् ill, bad, वाद speaking.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Irresistible, not to be prevented or checked.
E.
दुर्, and वार preventing.

mfn. (-साः-साः-सः)
Ill dressed.
m. (-साः)
The name of a Ṛṣi or saint, the son of ATRI, and an incarnation or portion of ŚIVA, famous for his choleric temperament.
E.
दुर्, and वासस् vesture.

mfn. (-धः-धा-धं)
1 Poor, pauper, indigent.
2 Wicked, malevolent.
3 Foolish, stupid.
E.
दुर् bad, ill, विध habit, custom.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ill mannered, ill trained or behaved.
m. (-तः)
A restive horse.
E.
दुर् with difficulty, विनीत led, managed.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
Incomprehensible, inconceivable.
E.
दुर्, and विभाव्य to be observed.

m. (-हः)
A bad mode or form of marriage.
E.
दुर्, and विवाह marriage.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Difficult to be sustained or supported.
E.
दुर्, and वि before सह to bear, affix अप्.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Vile, wicked, leading a low or infamous life, following disreputable habits or business, a cheat, a juggler, a rogue, a blackguard, &c.
E.
दुर् bad, वृत to be or abide, affix क्त.

f. (-त्तिः)
1 Leading a disreputable life, following a degrading business, &c.
2 Juggling, fraud.
E.
